instructions:
## Objective

Accelerate Qwen3.5-9B decoding through its multi-token prediction head.

## Work to perform

Optimize drafting, verification, caching, rollback and optionally head weights within plain PyTorch. Every accepted output token must match the pristine greedy model. Local checks and development benchmarks are unrestricted.

## Deliverable

Submitted mtpspec decoder tree.

## Evaluation

Geometric mean of memory-adjusted tokens/second over fresh-process prompts; exactness, loading, artifact and deadline gates apply. Evaluation uses draft depth 8 and a 512-token window.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
